# Industry Foundation Classes (IFC)

**Maintainer ecosystem:** buildingSMART International  
**Role in ARCA:** authoritative/intermediate open BIM exchange representation

ARCA's founding workflow accepts IFC directly and also uses IFC4 as the
intermediate representation produced by the current SKP adapter path.

ARCA does not claim ownership of the IFC standard and does not claim
buildingSMART certification merely by consuming IFC syntax/entities.

Future IFC support should document:

- schema versions tested;
- geometry entities supported;
- georeferencing entities supported;
- unsupported entities and fallback behavior.
